Plain facts for `nyx info` and bug reports: version and build, mode (`rootful`, `rootless`,
`userns-remap`), network driver, storage and log directories with free space, kernel, cgroup v2
and whether resource limits apply, AppArmor, the crun binary and version, and container and
image counts. Fields that could not be read are empty.
